name: dev.workers.b2bintel-edge.defi-route-intel/mcp-apps-interactive-defi-checkout-ui-mcp

tools.name: scan_perp_funding_spreads
tools.description: Returns live annualized perpetual futures funding rate spreads across Hyperliquid L1, Kraken Futures, and Bybit Linear Perps.

tools.name: compare_pendle_fixed_vs_funding
tools.description: Compares $3M+ TVL Pendle fixed-rate Principal Token (PT) implied APYs against live Hyperliquid perpetual funding carry benchmarks.

stablecoinOnly.description: Filter to stablecoin Pendle pools only (default false)

tools.name: scan_prediction_market_odds
tools.description: Fetches live macro, crypto, and policy implied YES probabilities across Kalshi (CFTC) and Polymarket (CLOB), including matched cross-venue gaps.

tools.name: get_institutional_stable_yields
tools.description: Returns verified $10M+ TVL DefiLlama stablecoin pools separating sustainable base fee APY from emission incentives.

limit.description: Number of top pools to return (default 8)

tools.name: quote_crosschain_usdc_bridge
tools.description: Quotes live net received USDC, gas cost, and bridge fee across Arbitrum (42161), Base (8453), Optimism (10), Ethereum (1), and Polygon (137) via LI.FI.

tools.name: quote_low_fee_dex_swap
tools.description: Quotes optimal non-custodial DEX swap output across Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Polygon (137), Optimism (10), and Ethereum (1) at 0.25% partner fee, saving 71% vs 0.875% wallet built-in swaps.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID ('8453' Base, '42161' Arbitrum, '137' Polygon, '10' Optimism, '1' Ethereum)

tools.name: build_smart_dex_swap_calldata
tools.description: Assembles non-custodial unsigned EVM transaction calldata (to, data, value, minOutAmount) across Relay, OpenOcean v4, KyberSwap, and LI.FI for any token symbol or 0x contract address at volume-tiered 0.08%-0.25% fees (saving up to 82% vs 0.875% wallet swaps). Includes interactive MCP App UI.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID ('8453' Base, '42161' Arbitrum, '137' Polygon, '10' Optimism, '1' Ethereum, '56' BSC; default '8453')

src.description: Input token symbol ('ETH', 'USDC') or 0x ERC-20 address (default 'ETH')

dest.description: Output token symbol ('USDC', 'ETH', 'cbBTC') or any 0x ERC-20 token address (default 'USDC')

sender.description: Optional trader EVM wallet address (0x...) that will sign locally

tools.name: check_krw_kimchi_premium
tools.description: Checks live South Korean Upbit KRW spot prices and KRW-USDT Tether implied FX against global USD perpetual mark prices.

tools.name: calculate_perp_liquidation_and_dca
tools.description: Computes exact isolated-margin liquidation price, distance to liquidation %, averaged entry after DCA/extra margin, and maker vs taker fee drag.

extraMarginUsdt.description: Optional extra collateral added without increasing size

dcaPrice.description: Optional second entry price for averaging down/up

dcaMarginUsdt.description: Optional margin allocated to second entry

tools.name: calculate_concentrated_lp_impermanent_loss
tools.description: Computes exact V2 full-range and V3 concentrated-liquidity impermanent loss (% and USD) vs HODL and calculates exact days of swap fee APR needed to break even.

depositUsd.description: Total LP deposit value in USD (default 5000)

concentrationFactor.description: 1.0 for V2 full-range, 2.0-5.0 for concentrated V3 range

tools.name: build_institutional_net_carry_dossier_x402
tools.description: Generates an execution-ready delta-neutral carry matrix (4-leg fee break-even hours, Pendle fixed vs floating edge, and live LI.FI USDC bridge route). $0.009 a call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base eip155:8453, saves ~45K raw market feed tokens).

tools.name: solve_defai_yield_and_execution_intent
tools.description: Resolves autonomous DeFAI agent intents ('maximize_stable_yield', 'fund_prediction_arb', 'delta_neutral_carry') into Half-Kelly position sizing, live >$5M TVL vault selection, and ready-to-sign non-custodial execution routes. Includes interactive MCP App UI.

chainId.description: Source EVM chain ID ('8453' Base, '42161' Arbitrum, '137' Polygon, '10' Optimism, '1' Ethereum)

srcToken.description: Input asset symbol such as 'ETH' or 'USDC' (default 'ETH')

estimatedWinProbPct.description: Optional agent true probability % (1-99) for Half-Kelly prediction sizing

marketYesPrice.description: Optional current market YES share price (0.01-0.99)

tools.name: build_crosschain_polymarket_bridge_and_rwa_tx
tools.description: Assembles ready-to-sign cross-chain bridge calldata (e.g. Base/Arbitrum -> Polygon Polymarket USDC.e) or converts idle 0% USDC into yield-bearing US Treasury RWA tokens (sUSDS, sDAI, wstETH, cbETH) at institutional volume-tiered 0.04%-0.10% fee (3-7 day RWA yield break-even). Includes interactive MCP App UI.

fromChainId.description: Origin chain ID ('8453' Base, '42161' Arbitrum, '1' Ethereum, '10' Optimism, '137' Polygon)

toChainId.description: Destination chain ID ('137' Polygon for Polymarket, '8453' Base, '1' Ethereum, etc.)

tools.name: build_mev_protected_flashbots_swap
tools.description: Pairs non-custodial volume-tiered swap calldata with private Flashbots Protect / MEV-Blocker / L2 Sequencer RPC routing so trading agents avoid 1%-3% public mempool sandwich attacks. Includes interactive MCP App UI.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID ('1' Ethereum Flashbots/MEV-Blocker, '8453' Base, '42161' Arbitrum, '137' Polygon)
